slides.text: Log tumhe serious kyun nahi lete (aur kya karna hai)
Tum har baat ke saath "sorry" ya "shayad" bolte ho. Seedha bolo: "Mera suggestion yeh hai."
Bahut tez bolte ho? Dheere bolo. Dheemi awaaz aur chhote pauses bharosa dikhate hain.
Baat shuru karne se pehle apna point ek line mein soch lo. Phir bolo.
Meeting mein kam se kam ek baar bolo. Chup rehne wale yaad nahi rehte.
Galti ho jaye toh seedha maan lo aur fix batao. Bahane dene se image kharab hoti hai.
Kapde aur presentation par thoda dhyan do. Log pehle dikhta hua dekhte hain.
Save karo aur apne us dost ko bhejo jo kabhi kuch bolta hi nahi.
slides.sub: Follow for one career rule a day

caption:
Serious dikhne ka matlab loud hona nahi hai. Clear aur confident hona hai.

Kaunsa point tumhe sabse zyada kaam ka laga?
